outcome: Time from oxytocin infusion to delivery
Indications for caesarean or instrumental delivery
cohort: The study included 160 women with twin pregnancies who underwent induction of labour at an institution in Hong Kong between 2012 and 2020, matched one-to-one with 160 singleton pregnancies based on parity, maternal age, and indication for induction of labour.
finding: Patients with twin pregnancies undergoing induction of labour had a significantly higher risk of caesarean section compared to those with singleton pregnancies (OR=2.14), although about three-quarters of twin pregnancy patients still achieved successful vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Twin pregnancies undergoing induction of labour had a significantly higher rate of caesarean section (26.3%) compared to singleton pregnancies (16.9%), indicating a higher induction failure rate for twin pregnancies.
